entries.00f0630f814f9f7d: Brake fluid and car care products
entries.13363b1546daad32: A single-segment business selling automotive lubricants under the Castrol and bp brands. Product development, raw material procurement, marketing and sales activities are performed in-house, and manufacturing is outsourced to domestic partner plants. Raw materials are mainly procured domestically, and some are imported from bp group companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥14,689 million. The head office (Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo) is the management facility for this business.
